title: Brewfather Mash Efficiency Drift
app: Brewfather batch exports, iSpindel and Tilt hydrometers, ESPHome mash probes, keg pressure sensors, brew-fridge telemetry, and cellar climate data via MQTT and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=brew:batch
| bin _time span=1mon
| stats avg(mash_efficiency_pct) as mash_efficiency_pct by recipe _time
| streamstats window=4 current=f avg(mash_efficiency_pct) as baseline_efficiency_pct by recipe
| where baseline_efficiency_pct>0 AND mash_efficiency_pct<baseline_efficiency_pct-5
| sort mash_efficiency_pct
description: Uses Brewfather batch exports telemetry to monitor how mash efficiency is moving against the recent recipe baseline in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for recipes that are slipping in brewhouse performance, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Brewfather batch exports data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
visualization: Monthly recipe chart of mash efficiency.
grandmaExplanation: It measures how mash efficiency is moving against the recent recipe baseline so you can spot recipes that are slipping in brewhouse performance before it becomes annoying.
